highlights: Gross Profit stood at INR 948mn (+20% YoY/+9.4% QoQ), below our estimates of INR 1,355mn; Gross margins contracted by 417bps YoY (+120bps QoQ) to 48.5% in Q2FY27, due to the mix shift toward lower-margin manufacturing-led defense programs and the loss of high-margin services revenue post the Accordis Phase 1 transfer.
EBITDA stood at INR 63mn (-68.5% YoY/-27.8% QoQ); below our estimates of INR 323mn.

EBITDA margin contracted by 1006bps YoY (- 153bps QoQ) to 3.2% in Q2FY27, due to a ~INR 120mn ESOP charge absorbing ~50% of EBITDA, ~INR 145mn of largely one-time legal and transaction costs, ~INR 150mn/quarter of unabsorbed corporate overhead, and EBITDA losses at AddSolutions.

PAT stood at INR - 482.6mn vs INR -24mn in Q2FY26; below our estimates of INR 305mn, and PAT margin stood at -24.7% vs -1.6% in Q2FY26, due to a ~INR 384mn one-time non-cash impairment of goodwill and intangibles (mainly AddSolutions) in continuing operations, with total exceptional write-offs at ~INR 583mn, none of which touch cash, customers, or orders.
valuation: With FY27 revenue targeted at ~INR 11bn, MSCI Small Cap inclusion, and a clean portfolio, the next phase is about converting the reshaped base into sustainable earnings.

Outlook & Valuation: AXISCADES enters H2FY27 (INR 6-7.2bn execution) with a cleaner, manufacturing-led portfolio anchored in defense, aerospace, and XIDA after completing Phase 1 of its ~INR 22.75bn divestment; Phase 2 closure by Q4FY27E should add ~INR 11bn in one-time gain and ~INR 12.74bn of guaranteed proceeds to cut net debt from ~INR 5.56bn and fund growth without dilution.

Core verticals are positioned to scale: defense carries ~INR 50bn assured forecast visibility, XIDA is expected to more than double FY26 revenue with ITSJ adding Google and Applied Materials, and aerospace gains full CloudWave contribution from Q3FY27, with each vertical targeted at ~20% EBITDA margin.
